name: Synthetic Social Network Demonstration Dataset
description: 60 synthetic user IDs arranged into three disconnected dense groups of 20 users each, with hub-like users inside each group.
format: Whitespace-delimited undirected edge list; one relationship per line.
attribution: Generated specifically for this project. No personal data and no external dataset attribution required.
note: This is not the Stanford SNAP Facebook dataset. The three disconnected groups are intentionally synthetic so Connected Components can be demonstrated clearly.
